name: app-blue-gradient-hand-held-phone-closing-banner
title: Weekly Project Closing Banner
whatItIs: A wide closing banner with black-to-blue gradient, big bold sans 'We launch a new project weekly!' with 'weekly' in blue, a tilted Follow pill, a like button, and a hand holding a phone showing a travel app.
whatItMeans: It ends the case study with a direct, upbeat call to follow. Floating social buttons make the ask visual.
techniques: Tilted follow pill as a playful CTA
3D like button floating in the space
Hand with phone anchoring the right

vocabulary.definition: The last frame of a case study with thanks and CTA.
UI elements like Follow rendered as objects in the scene.
Type filled with a gradient rather than a flat color.
